basic_info_description:
This beautiful Arts and Crafts style Edwardian house built in 1918 has been remodeled and refreshed. It offers formal rooms, lush wood detail, and warm natural light. The walk-out garden/backyard is perfect for gatherings and outdoor barbeques. Located on a flat quiet block in Mission Terrace conveniently located to Balboa Park playground, BART, Muni, Mission Street shops, restaurants, schools and 280 Freeway. 

* Two Spacious Bedrooms upstairs with walk-in closets 

* One Remodeled Ceramic Slate Bathroom with shower over tub and custom recessed lighting upstairs. A second remodeled watercloset is located downstairs 

* Formal Entry with hardwood floors, lush wood detail, beautiful light fixture and staircase 

* Formal Living Room with fireplace, recessed lighting, coved ceilings, hardwood floors 

* Large Formal Dining Room with built-in credenza, exquisite light fixture, recessed lighting, hardwood floors, lush wood paneling and wainscoting

* Modern Kitchen. Gas range with stainless steel chimney vent hood, refrigerator/freezer, dishwasher, ceramic sink, walk-in pantry, track lighting 

* Sunny Home Office adjacent kitchen with garden outlook. There is direct access to the back yard and a water closet off this room 

* Double thermo paned windows throughout entire house

* Refinished hardwood floors throughout 

* Modern Central Heating, Modern Electrical, Modern Plumbing, Weatherization

* Washer and Dryer 

* Seismically upgraded 

* Huge garage with additional parking on driveway for total three cars off street parking 

* Amazing storage space 

* Garden in large back yard 

Residents will enjoy all modern amenities in restored period architecture. 

Living space is 1300 sq ft on two floors -plus- basement garage is 800 sq ft.

Owner requests two months security deposit plus first month rent for move-in.

Please, no pets and no smoking. 

$3,500 per month.

Available November 7.

Qualification Guidelines:
1.	$126,000 annual household income  (33% maximum rent-to-income ratio)
2.	40% maximum total debt-to-income ratio
3.	Excellent credit history.   No prior evictions.   No bounced checks.
